  [ 13811]      #ifdef GL_ES\n
                precision mediump float;\n
                #endif\n
                varying vec4 v_fragmentColor;\n
                varying vec2 v_texCoord;\n
                uniform sampler2D u_texture;\n
                uniform vec3 u_lum;\n
                void main(void) {\n
                    vec4 color = texture2D(u_texture, v_texCoord);\n
                    float gray = dot(color.rgb * v_fragmentColor.rgb, u_lum);\n
                    float normalization = (v_fragmentColor.r + v_fragmentColor.g + v_fragmentColor.b) / 3.0;\n
                    gray /= normalization;  // Adjust for tint brightness\n
                    gl_FragColor = vec4(v_fragmentColor.rgb*vec3(gray), color.a * v_fragmentColor.a);\n
                }\n

                \n

                varying vec2 v_texCoord;                                    \n

                vec3 rgbColor = u_hue * pixColor.rgb * v_fragmentColor.rgb;                   \n

                }                                                           \n

  [ 43708]  Audio
  [ 43710]  Other
  [ 43718]  Auto-Retry
  [ 43728]  Restarts level upon death automatically.
  [ 43758]  Enable Faster Reset
  [ 43770]  Restarts in 0.5s instead of 1.0s upon death.
  [ 437a0]  Click Between Steps
  [ 437b8]  0177
  [ 437c0]  Toggles substeps on, allowing you to click in-between the default normal steps. This may affect performance.
  [ 43830]  Click On Steps
  [ 43840]  0176
  [ 43848]  Allows you to click on every step, regardless of your refresh rate. This is beneficial for users below 240 Hz.
  [ 438b8]  Flip 2-Player\n
            Controls
  [ 438d0]  Flips which side controls which player during 2-player mode.
  [ 43910]  Always Limit\n
            Controls
  [ 43928]  Limits player 1 controls to one side even when dual mode is inactive.
  [ 43970]  Hide Attempts
  [ 43980]  Hides the attempt counter when playing levels.
  [ 439b0]  Flip Pause Button
  [ 439c8]  Flips the location of the pause button.
  [ 439f0]  Disable Portal Guide
  [ 43a08]  0129
  [ 43a10]  Disables extra indicators on portals.
  [ 43a38]  Enable Orb Guide
  [ 43a50]  0130
  [ 43a58]  Enables extra indicators on orbs.
  [ 43a80]  Disable Orb Scale
  [ 43a98]  Disables the scaling effect on all orbs.
  [ 43ac8]  Disable Trigger\n
            Orb Scale
  [ 43ae8]  Disables the scaling effect on only trigger orbs.
  [ 43b20]  Disable Shake
  [ 43b30]  Disables shake effects.
  [ 43b48]  Disable Explosion\n
            Shake
  [ 43b60]  Disables the shake effect that happens upon death.
  [ 43b98]  Disable Gravity\n
            Effect
  [ 43bb0]  Disables the effect that happens upon changing gravity.
  [ 43be8]  Default Mini Icon
  [ 43c00]  Sets player icon in mini mode to default.
  [ 43c30]  Switch Spider\n
            Teleport Color
  [ 43c50]  Toggles between main and secondary color for the teleport effect in spider mode.
  [ 43ca8]  Switch Dash\n
            Fire Color
  [ 43cc0]  Toggles between main and secondary color for the fire effect from dash orbs.
  [ 43d10]  Switch Wave\n
            Trail Color
  [ 43d28]  Toggles between main and secondary color for the trail in wave mode.
  [ 43d70]  Hide Playtest Text
  [ 43d88]  Hides text in the top left when using start positions or ignore damage.
  [ 43dd0]  Hitbox On Death
  [ 43de0]  Shows hitboxes upon death in both normal and practice mode.
  [ 43e20]  Hides the attempt counter when playing levels in practice mode.
  [ 43e60]  Enable Auto-Checkpoints
  [ 43e78]  Places checkpoints automatically in practice mode.
  [ 43eb0]  Enable Quick\n
            Checkpoints
  [ 43ed0]  0068
  [ 43ed8]  Tries to place checkpoints more often in practice mode.
  [ 43f10]  Enable Death Effect
  [ 43f28]  Shows death effects in practice mode.
  [ 43f50]  Enable Normal Music\n
            In Editor
  [ 43f70]  Plays normal music in sync to editor levels in practice mode.
  [ 43fb0]  Shows hitboxes while in practice mode.
  [ 43fd8]  Disable Player Hitbox
  [ 43ff0]  Disables the player's hitbox in practice mode\n
            (if hitboxes are shown).
  [ 44038]  Enable Smooth Fix
  [ 44050]  Makes some optimizations that can reduce lag. Disable if game speed becomes inconsistent.
  [ 440b0]  Increase Draw Capacity
  [ 440c8]  0066
  [ 440d0]  Increases draw capacity for batch nodes at level start. Can improve performance on some levels, but may cause issues on low-end devices.
  [ 44160]  Enable Low Detail
  [ 44178]  Enables low detail mode on levels that support it automatically.
  [ 441c0]  Disable High Object\n
            Alert
  [ 441e0]  Removes the alert shown when starting levels with a high object count.
  [ 44228]  Enable Extra LDM
  [ 44240]  0136
  [ 44248]  Removes glow and enter effects while in low detail mode. Levels without LDM show LDM Lite.
  [ 442a8]  Increase Maximum\n
            Levels
  [ 442c0]  Increases maximum locally saved levels from 10 to 100. This refers to level data, not statistics. Enabling this can make your save file considerably larger, so keeping the option off is recommended for quicker saving.
  [ 443a0]  Disable Level Saving
  [ 443b8]  Saves level statistics as usual, but levels need to be redownloaded every time you restart the game. Makes saving and loading faster.
  [ 44440]  Save Gauntlets
  [ 44450]  Saves gauntlet levels locally so they do not have to be redownloaded. Increases save time but helpful if you have poor connection.
  [ 444d8]  Disable Shader\n
            Anti-Aliasing
  [ 444f8]  0155
  [ 44500]  Disables anti-aliasing on shader effects.
  [ 44530]  Disable Song Alert
  [ 44548]  Removes the alert shown when starting levels without the song downloaded.
  [ 44598]  No Song Limit
  [ 445a8]  Stops automatic deletion of custom songs. This is done by default to save space.
  [ 44600]  Reduce Quality\n
            (Read Info)
  [ 44620]  Lowers audio sampling rate from 44100 Hz to 24000 Hz. Requires restarting to take effect.
  [ 44680]  Audio Fix 01
  [ 44690]  Increases the audio buffer size, which may fix certain issues. Do not enable if audio is working fine. Causes a slight more audio delay. Requires restarting to take effect.
  [ 44740]  More Comments
  [ 44750]  Shows more comments per page. Why not?
  [ 44778]  Load Comments
  [ 44788]  0090
  [ 44790]  Loads comments automatically.
  [ 447b0]  New Completed Filter
  [ 447c8]  Makes completed levels filter based only on percentage from update 2.1. Useful to rebeat levels for Mana Orbs.
  [ 44838]  Increase Local Levels\n
            Per Page
  [ 44858]  Increases created and saved levels per page from 10 to 20.
  [ 44898]  Manual Level Order
  [ 448b0]  Places new levels last in the saved levels list. Useful if you want to manually move levels to the top.
  [ 44918]  Percentage Decimals
  [ 44930]  Shows decimals in level progress.
  [ 44958]  Show Leaderboard\n
            Percentage
  [ 44978]  Toggles viewing the leaderboard percentage you have on levels. To upload your level progress to the level leaderboard, you need to replay levels completed before 2.11.
  [ 44a20]  Do Not...
  [ 44a30]  Does not do anything... Well, nothing useful.
  [ 44a60]  Confirm Exit
  [ 44a70]  Adds an extra confirmation window when exiting levels.
  [ 44aa8]  Fast\n
            Menu
  [ 44ab8]  Makes transitions between menu pages faster.

  [ 5c498]  The <cg>Top 100</c> leaderboard shows the players with the most <cy>Stars</c> in the game. Players must be <cl>manually whitelisted</c> by a Leaderboard Moderator to appear here, ensuring legitimate rankings.
  [ 5c570]  Creators
  [ 5c580]  The <cg>Creators</c> leaderboard is sorted by amount of Creator Points. Creating a rated level rewards 1, <cy>Featured</c> rewards 2, <co>Epic</c> rewards 3, <cp>Legendary</c> rewards 4, and <cj>Mythic</c> rewards 5.
  [ 5c660]  Global
  [ 5c668]  The <cg>Global</c> leaderboard shows players in order of <cy>Stars</c>.\n

  [ 6d690]  Setup Static Camera
  [ 6d6a8]  Makes the camera <cg>static</c> around a target object.\n
            <cy>Follow</c> makes the camera change according to the object's movement.\n
            <cl>Smooth Velocity</c> makes the transition to the target adapt to current camera velocity. Recommended no easing.\n
            <cp>Duration</c> is how long the camera takes to change to the target object.\n
            Use another trigger with <cr>Exit Static</c> to stop.

  [ 6dae0]  End Trigger
  [ 6daf0]  Sets a specific object given by <cg>Group ID</c> to be the <cy>end</c> of the level when the game type is Classic. This essentially spawns the endwall at a set location.\n
            Use <cl>Reversed</c> if gameplay is reverse at the end.\n
            <cp>Lock Y</c> locks the endwall to the ground instead of the group's Y position.

  [ 6dc40]  Setup End
  [ 6dc50]  Sets a specific object given by <cg>TargetPos</c> to be the <cy>end</c> of the level. The player is pulled into the end instantly.\n
            <cl>SpawnID</c> lets you spawn a group at the end.\n
            <cp>Instant</c> teleports the player to the end instantly instead of the default gradual pull.\n
            <cr>No Effects</c> disables visual end effects.\n
            <co>No SFX</c> disables end sound effects.

  [ 6e278]  <cg>Add</c> assigns up to 10 groups to the selected object(s).\n
             <cy>P</c> sets a single object as group parent.\n
            <cl>Editor L1 and L2</c> places the object(s) on an editor layer.\n
            <cp>Z layer</c> sets the draw layer of the object(s). T layers are above, while B layers are below the player.\n
            <cr>Z order</c> sets the draw order of the object(s) within the Z layer.\n
            <ca>CH</c> sets the channel of the object(s).\n
            <co>ORD</c> sets the order of the object(s).\n
            <cj>Extra</c> has more advanced options.\n
            <cg>Preview</c> makes touch toggled triggers preview in editor.\n
            <cy>Playback</c> starts playback from this object.

  [ 73050]  19SetupTransformPopup
  [ 73070]  Setup Scale Command
  [ 73088]  <cg>Scales</c> a specific <cy>Target Group ID</c>.\n
            <cl>Center Group ID</c> specifies a target object to use as the center. If none is set, all objects use their own center.\n
            <cp>Duration</c> specifies how long the scaling lasts.\n
            <cr>Div by Value X/Y</c> divides the current scale by the values.\n
            <co>Only Move</c> makes the objects move as if they were scaled.\n
            <ca>Relative Rotation</c> rotates the X- and Y-axis too.\n
            <cj>Relative Scale</c> bases scaling on the reference object.
  [ 73268]  Only\n
            Move
  [ 73278]  ScaleY:
  [ 73280]  Div by Value X
  [ 73290]  Div by Value Y
  [ 732a0]  Relative\n

  [ 732b0]  Relative\n
            Rotation

  [ 732f0]  21SetupSongTriggerPopup
  [ 73310]  Song Trigger
  [ 73320]  Lets you start a specified <cg>song</c>.\n
            A single track can be active in each <cy>Channel</c> at a time.\n
            <cl>Start, End, FadeIn, and FadeOut</c> are in milliseconds.\n
            <cp>Prep</c> is used to ensure exact sync to a specified time as there may be some delay loading it normally. Use this option on a trigger to prepare the song before you want it to start, and then use <cr>Load Prep</c> when you want it to start. Note that only one Prep can be active at a time per channel.

  [ 78e30]  <cg>VelMod</c> modifies the velocity after switching rotation.\n
            <cy>Override Velocity</c> sets the velocity instead of multiplying.\n
            <cl>Change Channel</c> allows you to specify which channel to switch to after rotating. Triggers in a given channel will only be activated when the player is in that channel. You can use <cp>Channel Only</c> to exclude gameplay rotation.\n
            The <cr>Rotate Gameplay</c> trigger direction determines how the channel's triggers are sorted. Upwards means smaller Y values are triggered first, right means smaller X values are triggered first, and so on.\n
            <co>Instant Offset</c> makes the camera update instantly when switching gameplay to the opposite direction.

            varying vec2 v_texCoord;\n
            uniform sampler2D CC_Texture0;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // COMMON\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform vec2 _textureScale;\n
            uniform vec2 _textureScaleInv;\n
            uniform float _screenAspect;\n
            uniform float _screenAspectInv;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SHOCKWAVE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform float _shockWaveTime;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveTime1;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveTime2;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveTime3;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveTime4;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveStrength;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveWaves;\n
            uniform vec2 _shockWaveCenter;\n
            uniform bool _shockWaveInvert;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveMinSize;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveMaxSize;\n
            uniform float _shockWaveMaxDistVal;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SHOCKLINE\n
            // ---------------------\n

            uniform float _shockLineTime1;\n
            uniform float _shockLineTime2;\n
            uniform float _shockLineTime3;\n
            uniform float _shockLineTime4;\n
            uniform bool _shockLineAxis;\n
            uniform bool _shockLineDirection;\n
            uniform bool _shockLineDual;\n
            uniform float _shockLineWaves;\n
            uniform vec2 _shockLineStrength;\n
            uniform float _shockLineCenter;\n

            // ---------------------\n
            // GLITCH\n
            // ---------------------\n

            uniform float _glitchTop;\n
            uniform float _glitchXOffset;\n
            uniform vec2 _glitchColOffset;\n

            // ---------------------\n
            // BULGE\n

            uniform float _bulgeValue2;\n
            uniform float _bulgeRadius;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // PINCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform vec2 _pinchCenterPos;\n
            uniform vec2 _pinchValue;\n
            uniform vec2 _pinchCalc1;\n
            uniform float _pinchRadius;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // BLUR COMMON\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform bool _blurUseRef;\n
            uniform vec3 _blurRefColor;\n
            uniform float _blurIntensity;\n
            uniform float _blurFade;\n
            uniform bool _blurOnlyEmpty;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // RADIALBLUR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform vec2 _radialBlurCenter;\n
            uniform float _radialBlurValue;\n
            #define radialBlurSamples 10\n
            #define radialBlurSamplesInv 0.1\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // MOTIONBLUR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform vec2 _motionBlurValue;\n
            uniform float _motionBlurMult;\n
            uniform bool _motionBlurDual;\n
            #define mbSamples 9.0\n
            #define mbSamplesLoop 9.0\n
            const float mbSamplesInv = 1.0/mbSamples;\n
            #define mbSamplesDual 9.0\n
            #define mbSamplesLoopDual 5.0\n
            const float mbSamplesDualInv = 1.0/mbSamplesDual;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // CHROMATICGLITCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform float _cGTime;\n
            uniform float _cGRGBOffset; // 1.0\n
            uniform float _cGYOffset;\n
            uniform float _cGStrength; // 0.02\n
            uniform float _cGHeight;\n
            uniform float _cGLineStrength;\n
            uniform float _cGLineThick;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SEPIA\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform float _sepiaValue;\n
            const mat4 sepiaMat = mat4(0.393, 0.769, 0.189, 0.0, 0.349, 0.686, 0.168, 0.0, 0.272, 0.534, 0.131, 0.0, 0,0,0,0);\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // INVERT\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform vec4 _invertColorValue;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // GRAYSCALE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform float _grayscaleValue;\n
            uniform vec3 _grayscaleTint;\n
            uniform bool _grayscaleUseLum;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // HUESHIFT\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform float _hueShiftCosA;\n
            uniform float _hueShiftSinA;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // COLORCHANGE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform vec3 _colorChangeC;\n
            uniform vec3 _colorChangeB;\n
            const vec3 _hueShiftK = vec3(0.57735, 0.57735, 0.57735);\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SPLITSCREEN\n
            // ---------------------\n
            uniform float _rowmod;\n
            uniform float _colmod;\n
            uniform float _rowmodCalc;\n
            uniform float _colmodCalc;\n
            uniform float _splitXStart;\n
            uniform float _splitXRange;\n
            uniform float _splitXRangeMult;\n
            uniform float _splitYStart;\n
            uniform float _splitYRange;\n
            uniform float _splitYRangeMult;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // FUNCTIONS\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // return 1 if v inside 1d range\n
            float insideRange(float v, float bottom, float top) {\n
               return step(bottom, v) - step(top, v);\n
            }\n
            float rand(vec2 n) {\n
                return fract(sin(dot(n, vec2(12.9898, 4.1414))) * 437.5854);\n
            }\n
                \n
            float noise(vec2 n) {\n
                const vec2 d = vec2(0.0, 1.0);\n
                vec2 b = floor(n), f = smoothstep(vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0), fract(n));\n
                return mix(mix(rand(b), rand(b + d.yx), f.x), mix(rand(b + d.xy), rand(b + d.yy), f.x), f.y);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // MAIN\n
            // ---------------------\n
            void main() \n
            { \n
            vec2 targetVec = v_texCoord;\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SHOCKWAVE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_shockWaveTime > 0.0) {\n
                    PRECISION vec2 p = (targetVec*_textureScaleInv - _shockWaveCenter) * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect);\n
            float dis = max(length(p), 0.0001);\n
            float k = _shockWaveMaxDistVal != 0.0 ? clamp(1.0 - dis * _shockWaveMaxDistVal, 0.0, 1.0) : 1.0;\n
            if (_shockWaveInvert) dis = _shockWaveMaxSize - max(dis, _shockWaveMinSize);\n
            k *= clamp(smoothstep(_shockWaveTime1, _shockWaveTime2, dis) - smoothstep(_shockWaveTime3, _shockWaveTime4, dis), 0.0, 1.0);\n
            // Ripples equation multiplied with ring circles so that it will be shockwave\n
            targetVec += k * ((p/dis) * sin(dis * _shockWaveWaves - _shockWaveTime) * _shockWaveStrength) * vec2(1.0, _screenAspectInv);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SHOCKLINE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_shockLineTime != 0.0) {\n
            float dis = _shockLineAxis ? ((targetVec.y * _textureScaleInv.y - _shockLineCenter) * _screenAspect) : (targetVec.x * _textureScaleInv.x - _shockLineCenter);\n
                    \n
            float k = _shockLineMaxDistVal == 0.0 ? 1.0 : (clamp(1.0 + (dis < 0.0 ? 1.0 : -1.0) * dis * _shockLineMaxDistVal, 0.0, 1.0));\n
            if (_shockLineDual) dis = abs(dis);\n
            if (_shockLineDirection) dis = 1.0-dis;\n
                    k *= clamp(smoothstep(_shockLineTime1, _shockLineTime2, dis) - smoothstep(_shockLineTime3, _shockLineTime4, dis), 0.0, 1.0);\n
            targetVec += k * sin(dis*_shockLineWaves-_shockLineTime) * _shockLineStrength * vec2(1.0, _screenAspectInv);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // BULGE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_bulgeValue > 0.0) {\n
                     PRECISION vec2 d = (targetVec*_textureScaleInv - _bulgeOrigin) * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect);\n
            float di = length(d);\n
            if (di < _bulgeRadius) {\n
            float fadeValue = pow(di / _bulgeRadius, 3.0);\n
            vec2 bulgedVec = (_bulgeOrigin * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect) + normalize(d) * tan(sqrt(dot(d, d)) * _bulgeValue) * _bulgeValue2) * _textureScale * vec2(1.0, _screenAspectInv);\n
            targetVec = targetVec * fadeValue + bulgedVec * (1.0 - fadeValue);\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // PINCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // Original function\n
            if (_pinchValue.x != 0.0 || _pinchValue.y != 0.0) {\n
                     PRECISION vec2 d = (targetVec*_textureScaleInv - _pinchCenterPos) * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect);\n
            float di = length(d);\n
            if (di < _pinchRadius) {\n
            float fadeValue = pow(di / _pinchRadius, 2.0);\n
            vec2 pinchedVec = (_pinchCenterPos * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect) + normalize(d) * atan(sqrt(dot(d, d)) * -_pinchValue * 20.0) * _pinchCalc1) * _textureScale * vec2(1.0, _screenAspectInv);\n
            targetVec = targetVec * fadeValue + pinchedVec * (1.0 - fadeValue);\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // GLITCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_glitchTop > 0.0) {\n
            // Random offset slices horizontally\n
            targetVec.x += _glitchXOffset * insideRange(targetVec.y, _glitchBot, _glitchTop);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SPLITSCREEN\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_colmod != 1.0 || _rowmod != 1.0) {\n
            float normalizedX = (targetVec.x - _splitXStart) * _splitXRangeMult;\n
            normalizedX = (normalizedX < 0.5*_textureScale.x) ? normalizedX * _colmod : (normalizedX * _colmod) + _colmodCalc;\n
            targetVec.x = _splitXStart + fract(normalizedX) * _splitXRange;\n
            float normalizedY = (targetVec.y - _splitYStart) * _splitYRangeMult;\n
            normalizedY = (normalizedY < 0.5*_textureScale.y) ? normalizedY * _rowmod : (normalizedY * _rowmod) + _rowmodCalc;\n
            targetVec.y = _splitYStart + fract(normalizedY) * _splitYRange;\n
            }\n
            // --------------------- --------------------- ---------------------\n
            // --------------------- --------------------- ---------------------\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // APPLY THE COLOR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            gl_FragColor = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec);\n
            // --------------------- --------------------- ---------------------\n
            // --------------------- --------------------- ---------------------\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // CHROMATICGLITCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_cGRGBOffset != 0.0) {\n
            float cVal = (v_texCoord.y+_cGYOffset)*50.0*_cGHeight;\n
            targetVec.x += (noise(vec2(_cGTime,cVal))-noise(vec2(0,cVal)))*_cGStrength;\n
            vec4 r = texture2D(CC_Texture0, vec2(targetVec.x - _cGRGBOffset, targetVec.y));\n
            vec4 g = texture2D(CC_Texture0, vec2(targetVec.x, targetVec.y));\n
            vec4 b = texture2D(CC_Texture0, vec2(targetVec.x + _cGRGBOffset, targetVec.y));\n
            vec3 color = vec3(r.r, g.g, b.b);\n
            if (_cGLineThick > 0.0) {\n
            color -= smoothstep(_cGLineThick - 0.01, _cGLineThick + 0.01, sin((v_texCoord.y+_cGYOffset)*300.0*_cGHeight))*_cGLineStrength;\n
            }\n
            gl_FragColor = vec4(color, (r.a+g.a+b.a)*0.3333);\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // GLITCH\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_glitchTop > 0.0) {\n
            // Offset one channel\n
            if (_glitchRnd < 0.33) {\n
            vec4 col2 = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + _glitchColOffset);\n
            gl_FragColor.r = col2.r;\n
            gl_FragColor.a = max(gl_FragColor.a, col2.a);\n
            }\n
            else if (_glitchRnd < 0.66) {\n
            vec4 col2 = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + _glitchColOffset);\n
            gl_FragColor.g = col2.g;\n
            gl_FragColor.a = max(gl_FragColor.a, col2.a);\n
            }\n
            else {\n
            vec4 col2 = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + _glitchColOffset);\n
            gl_FragColor.b = col2.b;\n
            gl_FragColor.a = max(gl_FragColor.a, col2.a);\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // CHROMATIC\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_chromaticXOff != 0.0 || _chromaticYOff != 0.0) {\n
            vec4 r = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + vec2(_chromaticXOff, _chromaticYOff));\n
            vec4 b = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + vec2(-_chromaticXOff, -_chromaticYOff));\n
            gl_FragColor = vec4(r.r, gl_FragColor.g, b.b, max(r.a, max(gl_FragColor.a,b.a)));\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // RADIALBLUR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_radialBlurValue != 0.0) {\n
            vec4 result = gl_FragColor;\n
            if (!_blurOnlyEmpty || result.a < 0.1) {\n
            vec2 uv = targetVec;\n
            vec2 blurVector = (_radialBlurCenter - uv) * _radialBlurValue;\n
            float modVal = 1.0 + 4.5*_blurFade;\n
            result *= modVal;\n
            for (int i = 1; i < radialBlurSamples; i++) {\n
            modVal -= _blurFade;\n
            uv.xy += blurVector.xy;\n
                ^I^I^Iresult += texture2D(CC_Texture0, uv) * modVal;\n
            }\n
            result *= radialBlurSamplesInv;\n
            // Output to screen\n
            if (_blurUseRef) {\n
            gl_FragColor = vec4((result.rgb + _blurRefColor * (1.0-result.a)), result.a * _blurIntensity);\n
            }\n
            else gl_FragColor = result;\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // MOTIONBLUR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            else if (_motionBlurValue.x != 0.0 || _motionBlurValue.y != 0.0) \n
            {\n
            //vec4 result = texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec);\n
            vec4 result = gl_FragColor;\n
            if (!_blurOnlyEmpty || result.a < 0.1) {\n
            if (_motionBlurDual) {\n
            for (float i = 1.0; i < mbSamplesLoopDual; ++i) {\n
            float modVal = 1.0 - (i * _blurFade);\n
            vec2 offset = _motionBlurValue * (i * mbSamplesDualInv);\n
            result += texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + offset) * modVal;\n
            result += texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec - offset) * modVal;\n
            }\n
            }\n
            else {\n
            for (float i = 1.0; i < mbSamplesLoop; ++i) {\n
            float modVal = 1.0 - (i * _blurFade);\n
            vec2 offset = _motionBlurValue * (i * mbSamplesInv);\n
            result += texture2D(CC_Texture0, targetVec + offset) * modVal;\n
            }\n
            }\n
            result *= _motionBlurMult; // 1/(9 - 20 * _blurFade)\n
            if (_blurUseRef) {\n
            gl_FragColor = vec4((result.rgb + _blurRefColor * (1.0-result.a)), result.a * _blurIntensity);\n
            }\n
            else gl_FragColor = result;\n
            }\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // GRAYSCALE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_grayscaleValue > 0.0) {\n
            float gray = !_grayscaleUseLum ? (gl_FragColor.r + gl_FragColor.g + gl_FragColor.b)*0.333 : dot(gl_FragColor.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb*(1.0-_grayscaleValue) + vec3(gray)*_grayscaleValue*_grayscaleTint;\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // SEPIA\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_sepiaValue > 0.0) {\n
            vec4 texColor = gl_FragColor * sepiaMat;\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb*(1.0-_sepiaValue) + texColor.rgb*_sepiaValue;\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // INVERTCOLOR\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_invertColorValue.a > 0.0) {\n
            vec4 texColor = 1.0 - gl_FragColor;\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb * (1.0 - _invertColorValue.rgb) + texColor.rgb * _invertColorValue.rgb;\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // HUESHIFT\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_hueShiftCosA != 0.0) {\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = vec3(gl_FragColor.rgb * _hueShiftCosA + cross(_hueShiftK, gl_FragColor.rgb) * _hueShiftSinA + _hueShiftK * dot(_hueShiftK, gl_FragColor.rgb) * (1.0 - _hueShiftCosA));\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // COLORCHANGE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_colorChangeC.r > 0.0) {\n
            gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb * _colorChangeC + _colorChangeB;\n
            }\n
            // ---------------------\n
            // LENSCIRCLE\n
            // ---------------------\n
            if (_lensCircleStrength > 0.0) {\n
                    float dist = distance(v_texCoord * _textureScaleInv * vec2(1.0, _screenAspect), _lensCircleOrigin);\n
                    float k = _lensCircleStart == _lensCircleEnd ? ((dist >= _lensCircleEnd ? _lensCircleStrength : 0.0)) : _lensCircleStrength * (1.0 - smoothstep(_lensCircleEnd, _lensCircleStart, dist));\n
            if (_lensCircleAdditive) gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb + (_lensCircleTint * k);\n
            else gl_FragColor.rgb = gl_FragColor.rgb * (1.0 - k) + (_lensCircleTint * k);\n
            }\n
            }\n

  [ 821d8]  Allow Multi-Rotation
  [ 821f0]  Allows multiple rotation actions to run on the same target group. This was not possible before 2.2.
  [ 82258]  Enable 2.2 Changes
  [ 82270]  Legacy compatibility pre 2.2. Should be enabled on new levels.
  [ 822b0]  Allow Static-Rotate
  [ 822c8]  Allow rotating static objects in actions and animations. There is currently no support for rotating static objects other than 90 degree steps, but use this option to allow it anyway. Hitboxes will not match the art. Can be useful in some cases.
  [ 823c0]  Enable Player Squeeze
  [ 823d8]  Destroys player when squeezed between two objects. This is on by default but only for levels after update 2.2 for legacy reasons. Cannot be disabled for platformer levels.
  [ 82488]  Fix Gravity Bug
  [ 82498]  Fixes an old bug that makes flipped gravity act differently than normal gravity. Old levels can break with this enabled.
  [ 82518]  Fix Negative Scale
  [ 82530]  Makes negative scaled objects collide correctly. Disabled on old levels for compatibility.
  [ 82590]  Fix Robot Jump
  [ 825a0]  Fixes robot jumps being bugged on slopes and/or pads.
  [ 825d8]  Dynamic Level Height
  [ 825f0]  Increases max level height dynamically (the same way as max length). This option is always enabled in platformer mode.
  [ 82668]  Sort Groups
  [ 82678]  Makes sure that spawn groups are triggered in the correct order (left to right).
  [ 826d0]  Fix Radius Collision
  [ 826e8]  Replaces the player hitbox with a circle (instead of a square) for interactions with circular hitboxes. This fixes some issues where collisions would not register.
  [ 82790]  Reverse Sync
  [ 827a0]  Slows down or speeds up the player when reversing direction using orb or pads to keep music in sync.
  [ 82808]  Decrease Boost Slide
  [ 82820]  Slide less after dashing or being launched by moving blocks in platformer mode.
  [ 82870]  Enable Impulse Fix
  [ 82888]  Fix moving platform impulse bugs in platformer mode.
  [ 828c0]  Mini Mode

  [ 828f0]  Players are controlled separately.\n

  [ 82e78]  <cg>GroupID</c> needs to contain a group parent.\n
            <cy>Duration</c> is time before next keyframe.\n
            <cl>x360</c> lets you do full rotations before next keyframe.\n
            <ca>CCW/CW</c> to force rotation in a direction.\n
            <cp>SpawnGID</c> lets you spawn a group at the keyframe.\n
            <cg>Prox</c> will spawn the group when close to the keyframe.\n
            <cr>Curve</c> uses cubic interpolation to the next keyframe.\n
            <co>Close Loop</c> returns to the first keyframe after the last.\n
            <ca>Preview Art</c> lets you preview the Group ID instead of an icon.\n
            <cl>Ref Only</c> will only be used as an inbetween frame.\n
            <co>Even</c> = time between each keyframe is duration / keyframes.\n
            <cr>Dist</c> = time between each keyframe is distance / keyframes.
